route.rationale: two new team verbs plus profile data

cells.title: Ship team profiles and the team profiles and team use verbs
cells.action: Implement team-profiles D1-D7 code. (1) Create packages/bee-rs/crates/bee/src/team_profiles/only-agy.json: name only-agy, a one-sentence description (every role of every runtime runs on agy herding agents: hydrogen writes, carbon reads, neon tests, neon-high reviews and plans), then the team and herding keys copied value for value from .bee/tmp/team-profiles/seed-only-agy.json. (2) New module verbs/team_profiles.rs: a const table of (name, include_str!) profiles; a typed TeamProfile parsed once; pure functions plan_apply(target: &Map, profile) -> (new object, changed: bool) per D3, shadowed_roles(profile, higher layers) per D4, best_match(profile list, merged team) per D6; try_native serving exactly `team profiles [--json]` and `team use <profile> [--global] [--json]`, using the same g_prelude/emit helpers models_group uses. Project target is ctx.root/.bee/team.json; global target is crate::config_layers::global_config_dir() joined with config.json (create the folder). Before any read or write, `team use` refuses per D5 when one of CLAUDECODE, CLAUDE_CODE_SESSION_ID, BEE_SESSION_ID, PI_SESSION_ID, ANTIGRAVITY_CONVERSATION_ID, CODEX_THREAD_ID, BEE_HERDING_WORKER, PASEO_AGENT_ID is non-empty; put that check in a pure function over a lookup closure so a unit test can drive it. Run the model check the way verbs/config.rs model_refusal does on the merged before/after config and refuse on a new problem. Write with the same atomic JSON writer split-team uses. Refuse an unknown profile naming the legal list. (3) Wire try_native into verbs/mod.rs beside models_group. (4) In models_group.rs add the D6 `profile` field to build_table's result and the one text line to render; keep every existing field. (5) Add team.profiles and team.use entries to generated/registry_payload.json in the same style as team.show (descriptions say what the verb does; team.use says only the owner runs it). (6) Unit tests in team_profiles.rs, every test name starting with team_profile_: every shipped profile passes D1 checks; plan_apply replaces team, merges herding.agents and keeps other keys; a second plan_apply reports no change; the D5 check refuses for each env name and passes with none; shadowed_roles names a local-layer override; best_match reports 84/84 for only-agy applied. Fix any existing registry or verb-count test the new entries move. No code comments.
cells.verify: PATH="${CARGO_HOME:-$HOME/.cargo}/bin:$PATH" cargo test --release --manifest-path packages/bee-rs/Cargo.toml -p bee --bin bee team_ && PATH="${CARGO_HOME:-$HOME/.cargo}/bin:$PATH" cargo test --release --manifest-path packages/bee-rs/Cargo.toml -p bee --test registry_contracts --test registry_dispatch

must_haves.why: The owner applies the agy-only team with one command, per project or for every project.
out_of_scope: changes to bee config set or the layer order
truths: bee team profiles lists only-agy with its description
bee team use only-agy writes team and herding.agents into .bee/team.json and keeps other keys
bee team use only-agy --global writes the user-global config.json
bee team use refuses inside an agent env and writes nothing
bee team show names the applied profile
prohibitions: No hand edit of .bee/*.json(l) state files

cells.title: Test team profiles through the real binary
cells.action: Independent tester for tp-1. Without reading tp-1's unit tests first, write packages/bee-rs/crates/bee/tests/team_profiles.rs that runs the built bee binary (copy the harness pattern of tests/config_verbs.rs: a temp onboarded repo, env_clear or env_remove of every D5 agent variable, BEEHIVE_CONFIG_DIR set to a temp folder). Cover: team profiles --json lists only-agy; team use only-agy writes .bee/team.json with the profile team and herding.agents and keeps a pre-existing unrelated herding.agents entry; a second run reports no change and leaves the file bytes equal; team use only-agy --global writes BEEHIVE_CONFIG_DIR/config.json, keeps a pre-existing ship_visibility key there, and names roles the project config shadows; team use with CLAUDE_CODE_SESSION_ID set exits non-zero, prints refused, nothing changed, and leaves both files absent or unchanged; an unknown profile refuses naming only-agy; team show --json after a project apply carries profile.name only-agy with applied true. Report any behavior that disagrees with CONTEXT.md D1-D7 as a finding, never adapt the test to it. No code comments.

must_haves.why: A code cell never certifies itself.
truths: the integration tests drive project apply, global apply and the agent refusal through the real binary
the integration tests are green

cells.title: Document team profiles in the knowledge bundle
cells.action: Write a new concept docs/knowledge/areas/onboarding/team-profiles.md in the same frontmatter and section shape as the sibling concepts in that area: what a team profile is, the only-agy profile and its role-to-agent map, bee team profiles, bee team use with and without --global and which file each writes, the shadow report, the owner-only refusal and why, and how bee team show names the applied profile; cite team-profiles D1-D7 by D-number. Add one short paragraph to host-project-artifacts.md (team.json can be written by bee team use) and to the-agy-belt.md (the only-agy profile puts every role on agy), and add the two verbs to command-surface.md where team show is listed. Run bee knowledge index if the area index needs the new concept and bee knowledge check on the touched files. No code comments.

must_haves.why: Behavior that moves syncs its knowledge in the same change.
truths: a team-profiles concept explains bee team profiles and bee team use with --global
the agy-belt and host-project-artifacts concepts name the only-agy profile

cells.title: Check the team profiles docs against the shipped verbs
cells.action: Independent checker for tp-3. Read each concept tp-3 touched and check every statement about bee team profiles, bee team use, --global, the target files, the shadow report, the owner-only refusal and bee team show against the tp-1 source and a real run of the built binary in a scratch repo with the agent env cleared and BEEHIVE_CONFIG_DIR set to a scratch folder. Write docs/history/team-profiles/reports/tp-4-docs-check.md: one row per checked statement with file:line, the evidence and PASS or WRONG. Fix nothing; a WRONG row is a finding. No code comments.

must_haves.why: A docs change gets an independent check against the code it describes.
truths: every team profiles statement in the tp-3 concepts is checked against the shipped binary
